_help: §EO.3–EO.5 (5 Oct, Mike by voice). First numbers by Claude (chat); the designer owns them. Additive. fae and rings are wired by Claude Code (6 Oct: FaeRings, Mushroom); gifts is not yet (see gifts._help).

fae.specks: glowing magic pixels shed while flying

rings.trust: per ring, hidden, grows on each return

gifts._help: [NOT WIRED YET — design §EO.5] Read by FaeRings.gift_light and FaeRings.lead_to_lair, which are stubs: they read these numbers and return false. Nothing calls them until the overrun village's restoring (§CN) hands the fae their gift.
gifts.lairs_per_village: rare and uneven: most none, a few one

ring_look._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.4 wiring (6 Oct). Where and how a fairy ring is drawn. chance_per_chunk: the share of terrain chunks (about 260 m across) holding one ring, rolled from the world seed and the chunk, so a ring is always in the same place. Never in water nor on a slope steeper than max_slope_deg. radius_m, mushrooms and height_m: the ring's size, how many mushrooms round it and how tall each stands. Colours sRGB: the caps (one per ring), the stems, the gills. sit_inside: how far in from the ring's edge counts as inside it (a share of its radius).

sitting._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.4 wiring. The game has no sit action yet, so crouched (Shift) and still (slower than still_mps) inside a ring counts as sitting in it, for rings.sit_seconds_min.

bands._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.4 wiring: rings.bands and moon_phase_sets_band. Each ring's fae are day fae or night fae (night_share of rings are night), rolled per ring. Day fae come while the sun is up at the ring; night fae while it is down, and (moon_phase_sets_band) only while the moon is at least night_moon_min_lit lit: on dark-moon nights they stay away.

trust._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.4 wiring: rings.trust. Hidden, per ring, kept in the world's save: one more each time the fae come to you there (at most once every grows_every_game_h), up to max. At trust 0 they show as a flicker: far_m off, for stay_s[0] seconds. At max they come to near_m and stay stay_s[1]; between, in proportion. Standing up or walking off while they are out scatters them.

fae_look._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.3 wiring. The three small earth fairies: size_m tall, uncloaked, glowing (they give off light, so they may glow: LOOK_REFERENCE). colours sRGB per band (day, night): never fire's orange, which stays the only warm light. Each casts a small light (light_range_m, light_energy) and sheds glowing pixel specks (specks_per_s, speck_life_s, speck_m across). They fly at fly_height_m over the ground at about speed_mps, wings beating wing_hz.
